# Evercraft Revenue War Map

Product key: revenue-war-map
Aliases: Evercraft Income War Map, Revenue War Map
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/revenue-war-map/index.html
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/revenue-war-map/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/revenue-war-map/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Career Command: Career moves and interview preparation can support income plans when the user chooses a job-change path.
- Systemia Field Library: Contractors and service operators can use proven operating playbooks when an income plan becomes a real service business.
- Evercraft Rewards: Local reward and savings opportunities can complement cash-flow improvement, but rewards are not counted as earned income unless actually realized.

## Use this capability when the user means

- I need to make more money
- how can I increase my income
- ways to earn extra money with the skills I already have
- side hustle ideas based on my skills and available time
- build me a realistic income plan
- what can I do with 5 or 10 extra hours a week to earn more
- help me turn my skills into income
- I need a plan to improve cash flow
- show me practical income opportunities for my situation
- help me prioritize ways to earn more without quitting my job
- create a personal revenue strategy
- track whether my income plan is actually working

## Authority

public discovery plus private account-bound revenue planning from user-supplied income, expense, debt, savings, skill, time, work and general-location inputs

## Boundaries

- planning estimates for revenue, startup cost, feasibility, timing and risk are not guarantees
- does not provide individualized investment, securities, tax, legal or credit advice
- does not recommend specific securities, funds, cryptoassets, options, leverage, gambling, borrowing to invest, market timing, predatory lending, illegal activity or deceptive business practices
- high debt should bias planning toward lawful practical cash-flow and cost-reduction paths rather than speculative risk
- do not recommend quitting stable work for a weaker opportunity without strong explicitly stated evidence
- self-reported earned revenue stays distinct from modeled opportunity revenue
- private financial, employment, skill, location and progress data are not public discovery data

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
